limitations: Only decision and execution task target adapters are implemented; other valid target types reject enforcement_unavailable.
Fixed Windows document operations are not a general OS sandbox or arbitrary external capability. InputAuthority depends on a truthful trusted host; replay does not recreate receipts or Sessions.
Governance caches rebuild from the complete fact history because the existing cache lacks a causal cursor; throughput and multi-host execution are unproven.
Expiry is host-ticked, with consumption-time deadline checks. Escalation records a route, not an external notification. There is no paid-model resource ledger.
Formal Verification remains INCONCLUSIVE; no lawful Task COMPLETED, complete M1 or complete M2/protocol acceptance is claimed.
